CREATE VIEW `${VIEW_NAME}` AS SELECT rawId,disposition,route,reasons,baselineJson,candidateJson,updatedAt,attempts FROM beta_parsed_event
CREATE VIEW `${VIEW_NAME}` AS SELECT rawId,stage,attempts,code,updatedAt FROM beta_processing_retry WHERE kind='INTERPRETATION'

CREATE VIEW `${VIEW_NAME}` AS SELECT evidenceId,transactionId,bankId,archiveFingerprint,status,reason,approvedInput,correction,interpretation,approvalRequest,observationRevision FROM beta_review_item WHERE recordKind='FINANCIAL'
CREATE VIEW `${VIEW_NAME}` AS SELECT rawId AS evidenceId,request FROM beta_processing_retry WHERE kind='APPROVAL'
CREATE VIEW `${VIEW_NAME}` AS SELECT bankId,referenceKind AS kind,suffix,status,assetLocalId,revision FROM beta_review_item WHERE recordKind='OWNERSHIP'
CREATE VIEW `${VIEW_NAME}` AS SELECT rawId FROM beta_parsed_event WHERE ownershipExcluded=1

CREATE VIEW `${VIEW_NAME}` AS SELECT rawId AS evidenceId, f_transactionId AS transactionId, f_bankId AS bankId, f_archiveFingerprint AS archiveFingerprint, f_observationRevision AS observationRevision, f_correction AS correction, f_interpretation AS interpretation, f_boundInput AS boundInput, f_observedAt AS observedAt, f_feeKnown AS feeKnown, f_feeAmount AS feeAmount, f_feeCurrency AS feeCurrency, f_balanceAsset AS balanceAsset, f_balanceAmount AS balanceAmount, f_balanceCurrency AS balanceCurrency, f_facilityAsset AS facilityAsset, f_dueAmount AS dueAmount, f_dueCurrency AS dueCurrency, f_dueDate AS dueDate, f_merchant AS merchant, f_counterparty AS counterparty, f_debitCardAsset AS debitCardAsset, f_debitCardLast4 AS debitCardLast4, f_debitCardParent AS debitCardParent, f_messageFamily AS messageFamily FROM beta_parsed_event WHERE f_present = 1

CREATE VIEW `${VIEW_NAME}` AS SELECT rawId AS evidenceId, a_bankId AS bankId, a_archiveFingerprint AS archiveFingerprint, a_outcomeAttempt AS outcomeAttempt, a_outcomeAt AS outcomeAt, a_nonFinancial AS nonFinancial, a_registryBinding AS registryBinding, a_boundInput AS boundInput, a_observedAt AS observedAt, a_balanceAsset AS balanceAsset, a_balanceAmount AS balanceAmount, a_balanceCurrency AS balanceCurrency, a_facilityAsset AS facilityAsset, a_dueAmount AS dueAmount, a_dueCurrency AS dueCurrency, a_dueDate AS dueDate, a_loanAsset AS loanAsset, a_loanType AS loanType, a_loanRemaining AS loanRemaining, a_loanRemainingCurrency AS loanRemainingCurrency, a_loanInstallment AS loanInstallment, a_loanInstallmentCurrency AS loanInstallmentCurrency, a_statementProved AS statementProved FROM beta_parsed_event WHERE a_present = 1
